QuestInfo.name: Honnou-ji Infiltration 1
QuestInfo.0: Plan out the Honnou-ji infiltration with Shingen.
QuestInfo.1: You should climb the eastern Honnou-ji wall then sneak in through the eastern temple wing. Kanetsugu will keep you company. Get to the eastern Honnou-ji walls by heading north from Momijigahara then rendezvous with Kanetsugu.
QuestInfo.2: You met up with Kanetsugu at the eastern Honnou-ji wall. This wall is all that separates you from the princess!
